Validate and store capture histories for conditional CJS models

Source: R/cmr-data.R
cmr_data.Rd

Validate and store capture histories for conditional CJS models

Usage

cmr_data(
  histories,
  id = NULL,
  observed = NULL,
  occasions = NULL,
  intervals = NULL,
  units = "occasion",
  end = NULL,
  frequency = 1L
)

Arguments

histories

Numeric/logical encounter matrix, individuals in rows and ordered occasions in columns. NA is allowed only where observed is FALSE.

id

Optional unique individual identifiers.

observed

Optional logical matrix marking surveyed encounters.

occasions

Strictly increasing numeric occasion values. Their differences define occasion order; use intervals to supply model-time lengths independently.

intervals

Positive finite interval lengths between occasions.

units

Non-empty string naming the time unit used by intervals, such as "years". Interval lengths are already expressed in this unit.

end

Optional 1-based administrative endpoint per individual. It is follow-up truncation, never the last sighting.

frequency

Positive integer history replication counts.

Value

A validated cmr_data object.

Examples

cmr_data(rbind(c(1, 0, 1), c(0, 1, 0)))
